notes: Each eval runs over a fixed denominator of passes (default 5) via run.py; the recorded per-scenario pass rate over that denominator is the deliverable. The bar is every assertion holding on every pass. Mechanical expectations are graded by grade.py, qualitative ones by judge.py.

evals.prompt: The file draft.md is our Q1 checkout status update. Rewrite it so the engineering leads it goes to can act on it after a single read.
evals.expected_output: Rewrite mode runs on the rewrite path. The delivered text reads plainly, comes in at no more than 75% of the fixture's word count, and carries all nine load-bearing items at unchanged strength and scope. The reduction comes out of the fixture's filler and restatement, never out of a ledger item.
expectations: The delivered text is at most 75% of the fixture's word count (graded mechanically against the fixture's own count).
Priya Raman is still the owner of the latency fix.
The Billing squad is still the owner of the retry migration.
The 14 March deadline survives.
The 200 ms committed p95 latency survives with its unit.
The 99.5% availability floor survives with its unit.
The must-strength obligations are still musts.
The Billing squad's retry migration is still a should, not upgraded to a must.
The enterprise-tenant exception survives, still scoped to enterprise tenants and still conditional on the contract renegotiation.
The causal link making the deadline follow from the contractual commitment survives.
The delivered text reads plainly: one idea per sentence on a real verb, active voice where the actor matters, no stacked clause chains, none of the source's filler or restatement.
The delivered text adds no fact, number, owner, date, or commitment absent from the source.
The delivered text carries no cascade of three or more sub-12-word bullets.
The source document comes out byte-identical to the staged fixture (the skill returns text, it does not edit the source in place).

evals.prompt: Rewrite draft.md so the leadership team reading it before Monday's review understands it on the first pass.
evals.expected_output: Rewrite mode runs on the rewrite path. The delivered text runs no longer than the fixture, keeps the argument as connected prose whose transitions carry the reasoning rather than a bullet list of stubs, and keeps the hedge on the uncertain onboarding-step claim.
expectations: The delivered text is no longer than the fixture's word count.
The argument stays connected prose: the signup-dip-recovers / conversion-compounds contrast, the budget-priority conclusion, and the self-serve concentration all survive with their logical joints.
At least four of the source's transition words survive.
The compounding mechanism — the argument's hinge — is still named.
The onboarding-step explanation stays marked as uncertain, and the pricing-page confound that makes it uncertain survives with it.
The delivered text carries no cascade of three or more sub-12-word bullets.
The delivered text is easier to take in than the one-paragraph source while staying prose.
The source document comes out byte-identical to the staged fixture.

evals.prompt: notes.md is my raw whiteboard dump from the incident retro. Turn it into a follow-ups document the on-call team can actually act on.
evals.expected_output: Write mode runs on the write path. The produced document states all five load-bearing items from the notes, opens with its main point, reads as connected prose, and introduces no filler or restatement.
expectations: Dana Okoro is named as the owner of the alerting rework.
Marco Weiss is named as the owner of the postmortem template refresh.
The 30 April deadline appears.
The error budget appears as at most 2 hours of downtime per quarter, with its unit and its window.
The error-budget bar is stated as a must rather than a target.
The document opens with its main point rather than background or a preamble about the retro.
The document reads as connected prose; a short parallel list is fine, a bullet dump is not.
The document introduces no filler and no restatement (checked both against a filler-phrase list and by the judge).
The document invents no owner, date, number, or decision absent from the notes.
The source notes come out byte-identical to the staged fixture.
